description: This file contains CSS styles for a Tic Tac Toe game frontend, including variables for theme management, layout styles, and responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main class for the application, centers the content and sets background and text colors.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles for the main game container, setting maximum width and margin.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Styling for the game status display, including font size and color.

classes.name: scoreboard
classes.description: Style for the scoreboard display, managing the flex layout and padding.

classes.name: score-item
classes.description: Style for each score item in the scoreboard.

classes.name: score-label
classes.description: Style for score labels, managing color and font size.

classes.name: score-value
classes.description: Style for displaying score values, highlighting primary color.

classes.name: board
classes.description: Style for the game board, using grid layout to manage squares.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Style for each square on the game board, including hover effects and winning styles.

classes.name: controls
classes.description: Style for control elements in the game.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Style for buttons used in the application, including hover and active states.
